church.label: Church / faith community
church.summary: Gathering-led, content-heavy, funded by giving rather than sales.
site_bias: wordpress
Weekly self-edited content (sermons, events, announcements) by non-technical staff is exactly WordPress's job; the plugin ecosystem covers giving, events and media out of the box.

nonprofit.label: Nonprofit / foundation (stichting)
nonprofit.summary: Mission-funded; donors and grants instead of customers.
site_bias: wordpress
Programme pages, annual reports and an ANBI/transparency page change often and must be editable by staff without a developer.

service_business.label: Service business / consultancy / agency
service_business.summary: Sells time and expertise to a small number of higher-value clients.
service_business.revenue: Projects and retainers, invoiced; deposits via checkout
site_bias: vercel_app
A service business sells through a small set of high-conversion pages that rarely change — a fast custom site beats a CMS unless the owner publishes regularly.

ecommerce.label: E-commerce (physical products)
ecommerce.summary: Sells stocked goods that must be picked, packed and shipped.
ecommerce.revenue: Per-order product sales, margin on goods
site_bias: wordpress
WooCommerce gives catalog, stock, tax and NL shipping zones on day one; rebuilding that in a custom app only pays off at real volume.

digital_products.label: Digital products
digital_products.summary: Sells files, templates or downloads — no stock, instant delivery.
digital_products.revenue: One-off digital sales; near-100% margin, fulfilment is a webhook
site_bias: vercel_app
The whole business is a funnel plus a fulfilment webhook; a CMS adds surface area and maintenance without adding sales.

membership.label: Membership / community / academy
membership.summary: Recurring access to content, community or software for a fee.
membership.revenue: Monthly/annual dues; retention is the whole game
site_bias: wordpress
Gated content, drip release and member logins are a solved WordPress problem, and the owner can add member content without a deploy.

education.label: Education / training provider
education.summary: Teaches a curriculum to enrolled learners, online or in person.
education.revenue: Course/cohort fees, sometimes subsidised or invoiced to employers
site_bias: wordpress
Curriculum pages and lesson content change constantly and are written by teaching staff, not developers; the LMS plugins are mature.

local_venue.label: Local venue / practice (appointment-led)
local_venue.summary: A physical place customers visit — books time or serves walk-ins.
local_venue.revenue: Per-visit services, packages, sometimes retail add-ons
site_bias: wordpress
Opening hours, menus, price lists and staff pages are edited by the venue itself; local SEO plugins and booking plugins do the rest.

saas.label: SaaS / software product
saas.summary: The product is software; the site only sells and supports it.
site_bias: vercel_app
The application is the product — it needs its own auth, data model and deploy pipeline. WordPress could at most host the marketing pages.

creator_media.label: Creator / media brand
creator_media.summary: Builds an audience first; monetises it through sponsors and products.
site_bias: wordpress
Publishing cadence is the business; the owner must post without help.

web_presence.title: Public web presence
web_presence.wp: WordPress site (block theme) — home, offer, about, contact
web_presence.app: Next.js site on Vercel — home, offer, about, contact

content_publishing.title: Content publishing (blog / news / articles)
content_publishing.wp: WordPress posts + categories; owner edits without a developer
content_publishing.app: MDX content collection — every edit is a code deploy

media_library.title: Media library (sermons / video / podcast archive)
media_library.wp: Custom post type + embeds (YouTube/Spotify), series taxonomy
media_library.app: Media index page fed by the channel APIs

events.title: Events calendar & RSVP
events.wp: Events plugin (The Events Calendar) + RSVP form

booking.title: Appointment booking / scheduling
booking.wp: Booking plugin, or embed the operator's scheduling SaaS
booking.app: Embedded scheduling SaaS (Cal.com/Calendly) + webhook to CRM

product_catalog.title: Product catalog (what is for sale, at what price)
product_catalog.wp: WooCommerce products/variations; Stripe as the gateway
product_catalog.app: Catalog defined in Stripe products/prices, rendered from the API

checkout_payments.title: Checkout & payments
checkout_payments.wp: Stripe checkout (hosted) linked from Woo/pages; iDEAL enabled for NL
checkout_payments.app: Stripe Checkout / Payment Links; iDEAL enabled for NL

donations.title: Donations & recurring giving
donations.wp: Giving plugin (GiveWP) or Stripe donation links + campaign pages
donations.app: Stripe recurring Payment Links + a giving page

subscriptions.title: Subscriptions / recurring billing
subscriptions.wp: Stripe Billing (portal hosted by Stripe), membership plugin for access

membership_access.title: Member area & access control
membership_access.wp: Membership plugin gating pages by plan; login lives on the client's site

courses_lms.title: Course delivery (LMS)
courses_lms.app: Course routes + progress store, or an external LMS embed

digital_fulfillment.title: Digital fulfilment (deliver the file / grant the access)
digital_fulfillment.wp: Stripe webhook → email delivery; WP only hosts the thank-you page
digital_fulfillment.app: Stripe webhook → signed download link + buyer email (Brevo)

inventory_shipping.title: Stock, shipping & physical fulfilment
inventory_shipping.wp: WooCommerce stock + shipping zones + NL carrier plugin
inventory_shipping.app: Custom stock model + carrier API — only worth it above real volume

crm.title: CRM — contacts, pipeline, running inventory
crm.wp: Operator-side CRM (not in WordPress); site forms feed it
crm.app: Operator-side CRM; app forms feed it

finance_admin.title: Finance & admin (invoicing, VAT, bookkeeping)
finance_admin.wp: NL bookkeeping tool + Stripe payouts reconciled monthly
finance_admin.app: NL bookkeeping tool + Stripe payouts reconciled monthly

email_marketing.title: Email list & broadcasts
email_marketing.wp: Brevo list + form plugin; broadcasts sent from Brevo
email_marketing.app: Brevo list + form route; broadcasts sent from Brevo

social_publishing.title: Social content production & scheduling
social_publishing.wp: Engage AI Content Studio inside wp-admin (owner-operable)
social_publishing.app: Content produced operator-side; owner approves the weekly digest

analytics_reporting.title: Analytics & presence reporting
analytics_reporting.wp: Engage AI plugin reports real page/post counts as ground truth
analytics_reporting.app: Analytics + the Engage AI server-side website probe

support_inbox.title: Support inbox & FAQ
support_inbox.wp: Shared mailbox + FAQ pages; replies drafted, human-approved
support_inbox.app: Shared mailbox + FAQ routes; replies drafted, human-approved

documents_contracts.title: Quotes, proposals & contracts
documents_contracts.wp: Template pack + e-sign SaaS, tracked on the CRM record
documents_contracts.app: Template pack + e-sign SaaS, tracked on the CRM record

people_roster.title: People, volunteers & rosters
people_roster.wp: Roster in the CRM; a public sign-up form on the site
people_roster.app: Roster in the CRM; a public sign-up route

donor_reporting.title: Donor & grant reporting (ANBI-ready)
donor_reporting.wp: Giving exports → bookkeeping; annual public ANBI page on the site
donor_reporting.app: Giving exports → bookkeeping; annual public ANBI page

custom_app.title: The product application itself
custom_app.wp: Not a WordPress job — WordPress can only market it
custom_app.app: The application, built by the dev swarm and deployed on Vercel
